name: Meera Krishnan
summary: ACCA-qualified accountant with 8 years of experience: 4 years in external audit with a mid-tier firm in Dubai, followed by 4 years in group financial reporting for a diversified holding company. Prepares IFRS consolidated financial statements for 14 entities, leads the month-end and year-end close, and manages the statutory audit. Fluent English; basic Arabic.

experience.description: Owns the quarterly and annual IFRS consolidated financial statements for 14 subsidiaries across retail, logistics and real estate. Leads a team of 2 accountants, manages the external audit, prepared the group's UAE Corporate Tax impact assessment and builds Power BI board packs.

Prepared monthly management accounts and IFRS statutory accounts for 9 subsidiaries including two DMCC free zone entities. Implemented IFRS 16 for 120+ retail leases, shortened the close from 12 to 7 days in Oracle Fusion and prepared quarterly UAE VAT returns.
Led audit fieldwork for 12-15 clients a year in trading, manufacturing, real estate and free zone companies; reviewed IFRS financial statements and coached associates in CaseWare.
Substantive testing on revenue, inventory, payables and fixed assets; stock counts; draft financial statements for small and medium clients.

education.institution: Westbridge College of Commerce, Kochi, India
